question: Does the current authoring pipeline WITH the new merge staging guards (+ beard and messy-hair fixes) give The Art of Strategy more visual meaning than its real production authoring, without more WRONG?

passages.H1: the-art-of-strategy b181-189 (Cuban missile crisis: commitment, burning the steering wheel), 8 sampled scenes
passages.H2: the-art-of-strategy b225-240 (fairness focal points, bargaining, the 2006 World Cup penalty), 15 sampled scenes
passages.independence: neither passage is in the sealed 'final' sample, its threads, or the post-run re-authored chunks 1-3 (critic 2026-10-30); nothing was tuned on them

arms.OLD: the book's real authored beats (written on pin 9e27acec), planned on current code
arms.NEW: one fresh author per passage with the current rules.md and the unchanged author prompt, the current merge (with the new guards) and one routine fix round, planned on current code

confound: the author differs between arms (production agent vs a fresh agent), and OLD was written under the older rules text; the comparison measures the current pipeline as a whole, not the guards alone
sampling: one still per scene at 60% of the scene, identical frames in both arms (identical segmentation), captions off
raters: mute-test style: 2 fresh sonnet describers per image, one image at a time, no narration; one strict judge per description gets the scene narration and scores correctness (CORRECT / NEUTRAL / WRONG), contribution (ADDS / TEXT_ONLY / NONE) and explains (YES / PARTLY / NO); arm labels randomised, the key stays judge-side
shipRule: SHIP the merge guards + beard + messy-hair lint to god-mode only if, counting all judged descriptions: (1) WRONG(NEW) <= WRONG(OLD) on EACH passage, (2) dead (contribution NONE) NEW <= OLD pooled, (3) ADDS(NEW) >= ADDS(OLD) + 6 pooled over the 46 descriptions per arm (~13 points). Otherwise they stay unshipped and the result is recorded. The bars in data/quality-policy.json are not touched.
